what: Scenes of the final pitch deck (artifact https://claude.ai/artifact/5hk8Ph1ZJNdYL2wFUEye26, PDF docs/zhol-final-pitch-2026-11.pdf; owner, 27 Nov 2026: «final pitch на все элементы бизнес-плана… чем это все отличается от Google Maps… solution именно заранее, именно для керриеров… мы хотим сделать network»). New scene types, used nowhere else: a mountain road tunnel portal, a hilltop radio mast above depots, a vineyard road. Zholdas looks at the viewer only on the cover and the last slide; on the network slide he talks into a walkie-talkie and looks at the depots. Owner, 27 Nov 2026, on the illustrations: «чё так по иллюстрациям слабо на третий воркшоп? … эталон был по иллюстрациям. Давай подстраивайся» — four more scenes and the Workshop 3 paper grain on every light slide.

cover-tunnel.jpg.scene: an Alpine road running into a stone tunnel portal, trucks and a freight train beside it; Zholdas on a roadside rock holds an open pocket watch (in advance) and looks at the viewer
cover-tunnel.jpg.processing: 21:9 (2688x1152), a 16:9 window from x=380 so he stands right of centre; 1920x1080 JPEG q84

network-mast.png.scene: a hilltop with a small radio mast; Zholdas talks into a walkie-talkie and looks down at a truck yard, a rail siding and a ferry pier, each with its own antenna
network-mast.png.processing: transparent, cropped to 2290x1440 so the hill runs out through the right and bottom edges; 1000 px PNG, placed in the bottom-right corner

close-vineyard.jpg.scene: a vineyard road in northern Italy on a clear afternoon, a truck climbing it, a freight train in the valley; Zholdas sits on a dry-stone wall and waves to the viewer

problem-quay.jpg.scene: a windy harbour quay, a ferry held at the pier with its ramp up, trucks waiting; Zholdas holds his cap down and looks worriedly at the ferry
problem-quay.jpg.processing: 2688x1520 to 1920x1080 JPEG, full-bleed with the paper veil on the left

what-band.jpg.scene: a panorama of road, rail and sea: trucks on an Alpine road, a freight train on a stone bridge, a ferry leaving harbour; Zholdas holds up a lantern and looks along the road
what-band.jpg.processing: 21:9 centre cut to 1920x600, the band across the top as on Workshop 3's overview

market-map.png.first_try: b89abd32-f76b-4931-a3d7-7ee79d69f505 (he looked at the viewer, redrawn in profile)
market-map.png.scene: a gravel yard with an easel and a felt map of Europe; Zholdas, in profile, pushes a red pin into the map, toy trucks and a train on a crate
market-map.png.processing: transparent, cropped to 2260x1620 so the gravel runs out through the right and bottom edges

gtm-door.png.scene: the yard of a small haulage company; Zholdas knocks on the office door with a folder under his arm, two trucks parked
gtm-door.png.processing: transparent, the yard already meets the right and bottom edges; 1000 px PNG in the corner
